svg.title: The stationary state is invariant. The isometry therefore respects simultaneous discrete rotation of the memory and relabelling of the ports. In particular, the common azimuth is not a separate time-varying source variable. There is a symmetry-preserving unitary extension with a fresh output blank |s⟩= m−1/2 P j |j⟩, invariant under P. To prove existence, the invariant subspace |s⟩⊗C4 and the image of V carry equivalent representations of the finite group Cm by (41). Their orthogonal complements have the same representation multiplicities, so choose a unitary intertwiner on each complement and combine it with V on the input subspace. This is a finite-group constructive existence argument, not an assertion of reference-free implementation under continuous U(1) or of a particular energy-conserving Hamiltonian. Physical phase stability and gate precision still require calibration at the declared accuracy. A clock supplies ticks separated by a chosen ∆t in seconds and routes the next fresh output register.
